_about: Worked examples transcribed by hand from Hull, Options, Futures, and Other Derivatives, 9th ed. 'page' is the PRINTED page; 'pdf_page' is the page index in the PDF in corpus/. Numbers are typed from the page, never scraped: the extractor garbles math symbols. Add one per evening; each is a test in tests/test_engine.py.
